mapper.sql: d.id, d.tenant_id, d.workitem_id, d.sdlc_step_id, d.status, d.gmt_create, d.gmt_modified, d.package_oss_ref, d.agent_id, d.agent_version_id, av.version_no AS agent_version_no, snap.id AS snapshot_id, CASE bound.source WHEN 'RECOVERED' THEN 'UNVERIFIED' WHEN 'RECOVERED_FROZEN' THEN 'RECOVERED' ELSE bound.source END AS snapshot_source, CASE WHEN av.id = a.online_version_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS current_agent_version, w.title, a.name AS agent_name, COALESCE(snap.sdlc_id, entry.sdlc_id, av.sdlc_id) AS sdlc_id, s.name AS sdlc_name

FROM dispatch d JOIN workitem w ON w.id = d.workitem_id AND w.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sdlc_step entry ON entry.id = d.sdlc_step_id AND entry.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = d.agent_version_id AND av.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND av.agent_id = d.agent_id LEFT JOIN dispatch_sdlc_snapshot bound ON bound.dispatch_id = d.id AND bound.workspace_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sdlc_execution_snapshot snap ON snap.id = bound.snapshot_id AND snap.workspace_id = d.tenant_id AND bound.source IN ('CAPTURED','RECOVERED_FROZEN') LEFT JOIN sdlc s ON s.id = COALESCE(snap.sdlc_id, entry.sdlc_id, av.sdlc_id) AND s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = d.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id

sql.if: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM status_node node WHERE node.id = w.status_node_id AND node.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND UPPER(COALESCE(node.category, '')) = 'CANCELED')

mapper.select:
SELECT worker.id, a.name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT d.agent_id AS id FROM dispatch d JOIN workitem w ON w.id = d.workitem_id AND w.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND w.is_deleted = 0
AND d.agent_id IS NOT NULL ) worker LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = worker.id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.name, worker.id

SELECT , d.version
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT d.agent_version_id, av.version_no AS agent_version_no, CASE WHEN av.id = a.online_version_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS current_agent_version, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM dispatch d JOIN workitem w ON w.id = d.workitem_id AND w.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = d.agent_version_id AND av.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND av.agent_id = d.agent_id LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = d.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id
AND d.agent_id = #{agentId} AND d.agent_version_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.agent_version_id, av.version_no, av.id, a.online_version_id ORDER BY av.version_no DESC, d.agent_version_id DESC

SELECT /*+ INDEX(e idx_dispatch_event_type) */ e.id, e.dispatch_id, e.step_id, e.step_key, e.step_order, e.step_name, e.event_type, e.event_time, e.gmt_create, CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('step.timing', 'step.started') THEN e.detail_json END AS detail_json, e.error, s.name AS fallback_step_name FROM dispatch_runtime_event e LEFT JOIN sdlc_step s ON s.id = e.step_id AND s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.dispatch_id IN
#{id}
(NULL)
AND e.event_type IN ('step.started', 'step.completed', 'step.failed', 'step.fix_required', 'step.reused', 'step.skipped', 'step.stale', 'step.cancelled', 'step.blocked', 'step.timing', 'session.interrupted', 'session.failed', 'session.cancelled', 'session.resumed', 'dispatch.paused', 'dispatch.resumed', 'dispatch.recovered', 'dispatch.executor_failover', 'dispatch.failed', 'dispatch.cancelled', 'dispatch.completed') ORDER BY e.dispatch_id ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT step.id, step.sdlc_id, step.step_order, step.name FROM sdlc_step step JOIN sdlc flow ON flow.id = step.sdlc_id AND flow.tenant_id = step.tenant_id WHERE step.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND step.is_deleted = 0 AND flow.is_deleted = 0 AND step.sdlc_id IN #{id}

SELECT dispatch_id, 'runtime.last_activity' AS event_type, MAX(COALESCE(event_time, gmt_create)) AS event_time FROM dispatch_runtime_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id IN #{id} AND event_type IN #{eventType} GROUP BY dispatch_id

SELECT dispatch_id, MIN(CASE WHEN event_time IS NOT NULL AND event_time < gmt_create THEN event_time ELSE gmt_create END) AS gmt_create FROM dispatch_runtime_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id IN #{id} GROUP BY dispatch_id
